title: psid_hash cross-module join policy (C7) — option (b): NO join by psid
decision: M6 does NOT join data across modules by psid_hash. Cross-module join keys are live_session_id, comment_id, messenger_thread_id (and attribution_id when M3 emits it). M6's psid_hash stays internal to M6 (M6-own pepper, identity/psid_hash.py); it is never used as a cross-module identity key.
rejected_alternative: Option (a) shared system-wide pepper via secret_ref (M5-own, M6-read) to join by psid_hash — REJECTED for now: it increases cross-module re-identification exposure and would need privacy/legal (Sếp). If ever adopted, M6's existing psid_hash values must be re-hashed or dropped.
authority_basis: chief-auditor confirmation QĐ-3(b) (XAC_NHAN_QD1-QD3_2026-09-07.md): option (b) does not expand re-identification, so it is within chief/tech-lead authority. Owner confirmed 2026-09-09.
conditions: no code path joins M6 data to another module by psid_hash
switching to option (a) requires privacy/legal (Sếp) + re-hash/drop of existing psid_hash
